access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-4.1 Nano release whose API page identifies gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-4.1-nano alias; OpenAI's deprecation page lists that snapshot for shutdown on 2026-10-23 with gpt-5.6-luna as the substitute model. ChatGPT, the GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 Mini siblings, later GPT releases, fine-tuned derivatives, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
The deprecation page records an announcement date, shutdown date, and substitute model for the snapshot
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
The only documented snapshot shuts down on 2026-10-23, about five weeks after review, with migration directed at gpt-5.6-luna
